checks.detail: The provider accepted a funded BSC mainnet job and submitted a result before the deadline.
The served result bytes reproduce the deliverable hash recorded onchain.
The result included health factor, liquidation distance, and five collateral stress rows.
The frozen job required Venus Classic; the provider identified the protocol only as Venus.
The provider reported a $43.13 difference from Venus getAccountLiquidity and marked its own cross-check as disagreeing.
The result did not identify the BSC block used for its calculation.

validation.boundary: The funded provider proved mainnet activation and attributable delivery, but it did not pass PositionCrew compatibility. Escrow settlement remains pending. No normalized result, eligibility, selection, or ranking was created.
